Title: LEA CS352
Product Description:
The LEA Professional CS352 is a 2-channel Network CONNECT Series smart amplifier delivering 350 watts per channel at 4Ω, 8Ω, 70V, and 100V (175W at 2Ω). Per-channel HiZ/LoZ selection and a network-connected design make it well suited to small and medium commercial installations.

Every channel has onboard DSP with input/output processing, parametric EQ, high- and low-pass crossovers, limiting, and delay. Three ways to connect (built-in Wi-Fi access point, existing Wi-Fi, or FAST Ethernet) simplify network setup. Power-over-network control, cloud monitoring through the LEA platform, and selectable 70V/100V/low-impedance operation per channel make CS352 straightforward to deploy and manage across zoned commercial audio.

Title: LEA CS354
Product Description:
The LEA Professional CS354 is a 4-channel Network CONNECT Series smart amplifier delivering 350 watts per channel at 4Ω, 8Ω, 70V, and 100V (175W at 2Ω). With selectable HiZ/LoZ on a per-channel basis and a compact 1U chassis, it is well suited to small and medium commercial installations such as houses of worship, hospitality, education, and corporate AV.

The amplifier provides three ways to connect (built-in Wi-Fi access point, existing Wi-Fi, or Local Area Network via FAST Ethernet) with no proprietary software required. An on-board Analog Devices Sigma 96kHz DSP with a 32-bit core supports 8-band parametric EQ per channel, crossovers up to 48 dB/octave, and real-time load monitoring. Through the LEA CONNECT cloud platform and browser-based WebUI, integrators can configure, monitor, and troubleshoot from anywhere in the world with no VPN required.

Title: LEA CS1504
Product Description:
The LEA Professional CS1504 is a 4-channel high-power smart amplifier delivering 1,500 watts per channel at 2Ω, 4Ω, 8Ω, 70V, and 100V, making it ideal for large-scale fixed installations that demand uncompromising headroom. As part of the Network CONNECT Series, it offers three ways to connect: a built-in Wi-Fi access point, an existing Wi-Fi network, or a Local Area Network via FAST Ethernet, eliminating the need to download proprietary software.

The on-board Analog Devices Sharc 96kHz DSP with a 32-bit core provides linear-phase FIR crossovers, up to 4 seconds of delay per channel, 16-band parametric EQ per channel, and real-time load monitoring. Through the LEA CONNECT cloud platform and web-browser UI, integrators can configure, monitor, and troubleshoot from anywhere in the world (no VPN required) while third-party API support enables seamless integration with Crestron, AMX, Q-SYS, and other control systems.
